newsitem.title: USA: BP Prudhoe stake raised by Robert Bass.
newsitem.headline: BP Prudhoe stake raised by Robert Bass.

text.p: A group including Texas billionaire Robert Bass said Tuesday it raised its stake in BP Prudhoe Bay Royalty Trust to 2,069,000 units or 9.7 percent of the company's units of benefical interest outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 240,000 additional units between January 10 and January 13 at prices ranging from $16.17 to $16.30 per unit.
The group previously held a 8.5 percent stake or 1,829,000 units.
BP Prudhoe of New York is a passive entity established by the Standard Oil and entrusted to the Bank of New York.
